title: Hearing a play before reading it
statement: Whether students should hear a play performed before reading it is unsettled, and an oral discussion of the play does not supply that hearing.
detail: Machine-made notes of a design meeting said a play reads dry because it was written to be heard, not read silently, that the usual fix is hearing it aloud before reading it, and that the unit's oral discussion lesson already provides this. Review separated hearing a performance, using read-aloud and explaining an interpretation orally as different activities, and found the oral lesson does not by itself set up listening before reading. No listen-before-reading step was built, so nothing has tested it.
